exposure: HIV+ black and HIV+ nonblack women
cohort: 178,972 singleton pregnancies from the Consortium of Safe Labor between 2002 and 2008 with documented HIV status, race, and antepartum admission.
finding: HIV+ women experience higher rates of obstetric complications and deliver at an earlier gestational age compared to HIV- women.
mod_finding: HIV+ women were more likely to have a cesarean delivery
gest_age: Earlier gestational age in HIV+ women
birth_weight: Lower in neonates of HIV+ mothers
